# Flexible eSIM Transfer 0.5.5

Fix standalone recording being affected by KernelSU Manager backgrounding.
Launch the recorder through the ordinary root shell, which leaves the Manager's
app cgroup, then detach its process session and input/output streams. Explicit
Stop, duration/size limits, private reports and refusal to overwrite an existing
report are unchanged. Recording never starts or resumes automatically.

The WebUI now uses its live recording status instead of retaining an outdated
“Recording starting” notification. Routing, native card-session ownership,
settings, profiles, scopes and restart behavior are unchanged.

Two independent alternatives, included together in every release:

- **`FlexibleEsimTransfer.apk`** — existing Vector/libxposed route, with its own
  settings, card picker and private diagnostic recorder.
- **`FlexibleEsimTransfer-Zygisk.zip`** — standalone KernelSU WebUI and native
  Zygisk/LSPlant backend. No Flexible eSIM Transfer APK or Vector required.
- Both use versionCode **13**, version **0.5.5**, and have individual SHA-256 files.
- Concise setup documentation and visible eSIM-loss warnings in both interfaces.
  Test a recoverable line first; recovery and use are your responsibility under
  the existing MIT warranty/liability terms.

Both routes share real destination/port selection, fail-closed download guards,
optional native card-session preservation and bounded redacted diagnostics.
The ZIP targets owner-user Phone, SIM Manager and Play services main/UI only;
other processes are rejected before Java/ART initialization. Its native bootstrap
still passes through the Zygisk provider before rejected processes unload it.

Use **one backend at a time**. New versions detect both implementations in the
same process and block routing; older APKs lack this guard. Settings remain
independent. No installer or UI silently disables modules, changes scope, migrates
preferences, restarts Android, or operates on SIM profiles.

Requires Android 13+, Google SIM Manager/Play services and a real Android-visible
active eUICC. The APK needs a libxposed API 101 framework. The ZIP needs KernelSU
Manager and a Zygisk API 5 provider. ZIP settings/diagnostics are root-only;
uninstall retains them. Export/delete/forget are explicit choices.

The recording correction has host/build checks; **device activation and
background-recording validation remain pending**. Play Integrity
interference remains unresolved; no DEVICE/STRONG result is promised. Native authorization, signed data, card errors
and carrier eligibility are not bypassed. Activation requires the device’s
supported restart procedure; preserve temporary root where applicable.

# Flexible eSIM Transfer 0.5.4

Fix standalone application startup when another hook engine deoptimizes
`Instrumentation.newApplication`. Bootstrap now hooks `Application.attach` once,
passes the real context directly to the shared router, and starts Phone inventory
only after native attachment succeeds. Application-construction callers are
deoptimized to prevent inlining from bypassing attachment. Native exceptions
remain unchanged. The companion-owned settings transport and fail-closed guards
from 0.5.3 are retained. Settings, profiles, scopes and restart behavior are
unchanged.

Fix standalone startup on ART libraries with compressed MiniDebugInfo. Required
private symbols are now resolved from bounded, validated `.gnu_debugdata` as well
as ordinary ELF symbol tables. Adds redacted bootstrap-stage and inventory-socket
readiness markers; no destination, profile, scope or restart changes.

# Flexible eSIM Transfer

Choose which real eUICC receives Android’s native eSIM transfers and new Google
SIM Manager downloads—including removable SIM-form-factor eUICCs. Includes a
card/port picker, optional session preservation, and private diagnostic export.

## Before you use it

**You can lose access to your eSIM and cellular service.** A transfer may
deactivate the source profile or consume an activation code even if the download
fails. Recovery may require your carrier to reissue the eSIM and may incur fees;
this module cannot guarantee recovery.

**Test with a recoverable, nonessential line first.** Arrange another way to
communicate and access your carrier account. You are responsible for your testing,
backups, recovery arrangements and decision to use this software. It is provided
**“AS IS”, without warranty**, under the [MIT License](LICENSE), including its
limitation of liability to the extent permitted by law.

## Choose one version

Download from [Releases](https://github.com/doccstat/flexible-esim-transfer/releases).
Every release includes both alternatives at the same version, with SHA-256 checksums.
Neither requires the other.

| Version | Requirements | Configuration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **APK** | Root + Vector or another libxposed API 101 framework | Included app |
| **Zygisk ZIP** | KernelSU Manager + a Zygisk API 5 provider | Module WebUI |

Both require **Android 13+**, Google SIM Manager/Play services, and a real eUICC
recognized by Android on an active modem port. Carrier and device transfer support
still apply. **Enable only one routing backend.** Settings are independent.

## Quick start

1. **APK:** install and enable it for owner-user **SIM Manager** and **Google Play
   services**. Add **Phone** scope if using session preservation.
   **ZIP:** install through KernelSU Manager, then open its WebUI.
2. Activate using your device’s supported restart procedure. Preserve temporary
   root where applicable; restarting Phone interrupts cellular service.
3. Refresh cards, choose the destination and active port, then confirm. Manual
   EID entry is also available. Enable **Preserve card session** if your card
   needs a continuous authentication channel.
4. Restart affected processes after changing settings. Start a fresh transfer
   or download through Android’s normal SIM settings and verify service afterward.
5. To stop routing, choose **Off / forget destination** and restart again.

Routing affects **all new SIM Manager downloads**, including QR downloads.
A port index is not a physical slot number. See the [usage guide](docs/usage.md)
for activation, card selection and switching backends.

## Compatibility and support

Incoming transfers and transfers back to an iPhone have been reported working
with the Vector route. The standalone Zygisk route still needs device validation.
**Play Integrity interference remains unresolved; no integrity verdict is promised.**

Both interfaces provide **Start / Stop / Review / Export / Delete** diagnostics.
Recording is opt-in, redacted and bounded; nothing uploads automatically. Review
exports before attaching them to a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/doccstat/flexible-esim-transfer/issues).
Do not share EIDs, activation codes, QR codes or account credentials.

The interface currently uses English. [Build/release instructions](docs/releasing.md)
and [dependency licenses](https://github.com/doccstat/flexible-esim-transfer/blob/main/zygisk/VENDORED.md)
are available separately. Third-party components retain their own licenses.
readmeZh:
# 灵活的 eSIM 转移

选择哪个真正的 eUICC 接收 Android 的本机 eSIM 传输和新的 Google
SIM 管理器下载 - 包括可拆卸 SIM 外形 eUICC。包括一个
卡/端口选择器、可选会话保存和私有诊断导出。

## 使用之前

**您可能会失去对 eSIM 和蜂窝服务的访问权限。** 转移可能会
停用源配置文件或使用激活码，即使下载
失败。恢复可能需要您的运营商重新签发 eSIM 卡，并且可能会产生费用；
该模块不能保证恢复。

**首先使用可恢复的非必要线路进行测试。** 安排另一种方式
沟通并访问您的运营商帐户。你对你的测试负责，
备份、恢复安排和使用该软件的决定。提供
**“按原样”，无保证**，根据 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)，包括其
在法律允许的范围内限制责任。

## 选择一个版本

从[版本](https://github.com/doccstat/flexible-esim-transfer/releases)下载。
每个版本都在同一版本中包含两种替代方案，并带有 SHA-256 校验和。
两者都不需要对方。

|版本 |要求|配置|
| --- | ---| --- |
| **APK** | Root + Vector 或另一个 libxposed API 101 框架 |包含的应用程序 |
| **Zygisk 邮政编码** | KernelSU Manager + Zygisk API 5 提供商 |模块WebUI |

两者都需要 **Android 13+**、Google SIM Manager/Play 服务和真正的 eUICC
Android 可在活动调制解调器端口上识别。运营商和设备转移支持
仍然适用。 **仅启用一个路由后端。** 设置是独立的。

## 快速开始

1. **APK：** 为所有者用户 **SIM Manager** 和 **Google Play 安装并启用它
   服务**。如果使用会话保留，请添加 **电话** 范围。
   **ZIP:** 通过 KernelSU Manager 安装，然后打开其 WebUI。
2. 使用设备支持的重启程序进行激活。保留临时
   适用时根；重新启动手机会中断蜂窝服务。
3. 刷新卡，选择目的地和活动端口，然后确认。手册
   EID 条目也可用。如果您的卡启用**保留卡会话**
   需要一个连续的认证通道。
4. 更改设置后重新启动受影响的进程。开始新的转移
   或通过 Android 的正常 SIM 设置下载并随后验证服务。
5. 要停止路由，请选择**关闭/忘记目的地**并重新启动。

路由会影响**所有新的 SIM 管理器下载**，包括 QR 下载。
端口索引不是物理插槽号。参见【使用指南】(docs/usage.md)
用于激活、卡选择和切换后端。

## 兼容性和支持

据报道，传入传输和传回 iPhone 的功能正常
与矢量路线。独立的 Zygisk 路由仍然需要设备验证。
**游戏完整性干扰仍未解决；不承诺诚信判决。**

两个接口都提供**启动/停止/查看/导出/删除**诊断。
录音是选择性加入、经过编辑和有限制的；没有任何内容会自动上传。评论
在将其附加到 [GitHub 问题](https://github.com/doccstat/flexible-esim-transfer/issues) 之前导出。
请勿共享 EID、激活码、QR 码或帐户凭据。

目前界面使用英文。 [构建/发布说明](docs/releasing.md)
和[依赖许可证](https://github.com/doccstat/flexible-esim-transfer/blob/main/zygisk/VENDORED.md)
可以单独购买。第三方组件保留自己的许可证。
